stop_detail: CodeAgent equips the LLM with five tools (DuckDuckGo web search, BM25-based repo-documentation retrieval, tree-sitter-based code symbol navigation, a Black-based format checker, and a code interpreter for execution feedback) invoked via one of four agent strategies (ReAct, Tool-Planning, OpenAIFunc, rule-based fixed ordering) to iteratively gather cross-file context and runtime feedback inside the agent loop (Sec. 3).

stop_detail: COLA builds cross-file context by alternating dependency-based snippets (SCIP-derived cross-file imports) and retrieval-based snippets (top-10 Jaccard-similarity chunks) until the model's context window is filled, then trains the LLM via SFT+DPO to attend to it (Section III).

stop_detail: Builds a static code dependency graph (calls, inheritance, imports, variable references) via static analysis, traverses it with BFS+DFS from K seed entities to form K×W fault-propagation localization chains, then runs a 3-round multi-agent debate per chain before MCTS-based patch generation (Sec 3).
